name: Demand Landscape
question: Is real end-demand for the product growing, stable, or shrinking — and is it paid, organic demand rather than channel, subsidy, or hype artifacts?

signals.description: Web traffic level + trend vs competitor set; company entities webTraffic.history across the Webset

recipe.query_template: web traffic level and trend of {company} versus {competitors}

signals.description: Customer reviews volume/tone trajectory; review platforms and trade press

recipe.query_template: {company} order book OR backlog OR bookings

signals.description: Price realization: waitlists/scarcity vs discounting/promotions; news + retail coverage monitors

recipe.query_template: {company} waitlist OR scarcity OR discount OR promotion

signals.description: Channel checks in trade press (sell-through vs sell-in); trade-domain-scoped search
End-market health (the customer's customer); downstream industry conditions
Search/attention trends reported by third parties; news coverage of demand indicators

grade_anchors.A: Multiple independent demand proxies rising together; pricing holding or rising; downstream markets healthy.
grade_anchors.C: Headline demand flat; mix of proxies; growth increasingly promotional.
grade_anchors.F: Proxies falling while management reports growth (see screen); demand shown to be pull-forward or subsidy-driven.

false_signals.description: Shipping to channel booked as demand. Distributor inventory coverage + returns/impairment news following strong quarters.

recipe.query_template: {company} distributor inventory OR returns OR impairment after strong quarter

false_signals.description: Incentives that borrow future demand (one-time discounts, expiring subsidies, pre-buy ahead of price rises). Agent run classifying demand drivers per quarter.

recipe.query_template: {company} demand drivers per quarter: one-time discounts, expiring subsidies, pre-buy ahead of price rises

false_signals.description: Company changes its demand KPI (users → "engaged accounts" → "transacting entities") when the old one stalls. KPI-definition tracking across consecutive earnings coverage; any unexplained definition change is an automatic flag.

recipe.query_template: {company} demand KPI definition changes across consecutive earnings coverage
